book.name: Luka
book.title: Malobhe gha Mbone ngita chighajhandikwe na Luka

content: Kujhighanikiwa kwa Yecho
Yecho pabhujhita kuhumii kulukemba lwa ku Yolodane, kongo atwelii twe Uhuke gwa Chapanga na kulongochwa nako ade kunjenga,
na kweni Limbembela lijhakujhighanikila kwa machiko makome ncheche. Kwa machiko gheniya ghoha atamita changalye kilebhe, na pighajhomokila machiko gheniya njala ijhakumina.
Bhahe, Limbembela lela lijhakunnobholela, “Anda chakaka mwe ma Mwana gwa Chapanga, longela lighanga lendeno libhehe libumunda.”
Nambo Yecho palongolila, “Majhandiko gha Chapanga ghilonge, ughome gwa ‘Mundo naupitila ndeka mukulye mabumunda.’ ”
Ndi Limbembela, lijhakuntola Yecho ade kululegheleghe lwa kitombe, na kunaha unahota gwa pannema ghoha kwa mala jhimo.
Peniya Limbembela nganongolila, “Unahota nkolongwa na ulumbililo ghongo ghoha nanipela henge yoha mwenga kubhehe gwino nhwalo bhambekii ghoha nenga. Na nihoto kumpekiya mundo jhojhoha jhunimpala.
Anda nnyeketile kunyinamila nenga, naibhaha hino.”
Yecho panyangwila, “Majhandiko gha Chapanga ghilonge, ‘Jwakunyinamila ndi Bhambo Chapanga, abhii jhe jhonge!’ ”
Ndi Limbembela, ajhakuntola ade ku Yeluchalemo, na kunnyemeka ku lulegheleghe lwa Nyumba jha Chapanga na kunnobholela, “Anda mwe ma Mwana gwa Chapanga, kiponeya pahe,
mana ijhandikwe mu Majhandiko gha Chapanga ghilonge, ‘Chapanga nalaghalikiya akatumiche bhake bha kunane bhanonde.’
Na kabhele, ‘Hote nantolela mu mabhoko ghabhe, nkotoka kukochoka mulighanga.’ ”
Nambo Yecho pajhangwila, “Majhandiko gha Chapanga ghilonge, ‘Nkotoka kunyighanikiya Bhambo Chapanga gwino.’ ”
Limbembela pajhomolila kunyighanikiya Yecho kwa ndela yoha, lijhakunekekeya kwa machaa.
Yecho itumbuu lihengo lyakwe ku Galilaya
Peniya Yecho ajhakubhujha ku Galilaya kongo atwelii twe Uhuke gwa Chapanga. Na malobhe ghake ghajhakuchobhela pa Galilaya na mu ilambo yoha ibhii pahina.
Bhambo Yecho patehila kubhola bhando munyumba jha kukonganikii Akayahude, kone alumbililwa na bhando bhoha.
Yecho ikanwa ku Nachalete

Bhahe, Yecho ajhakujhenda ku Nachalete, ndi kwakolila. Pilihikita Lichiko lya Kupomolela, ajhakujhingii nkate munyumba jha kukonganikii Akayahude, ngita chibhakayobhalile. Pakibha mwenio ajhakujhema na apata kwachomela Majhandiko gha Chapanga kanonoha,
ajhakupelwa kitabo chikijhandikwe na Isaya jwakibha nnondole jwa Chapanga, ajhakukiyekula na kupalaha chehemo jhijhandikwe.

content.text: ahagwii nenga kwalobholela akahocho Malobhe gha Mbone.
Andumite kwalobholela bhibhabhii mu kipungo kudindulilwa kwabhe,
na bhangalola, na bhene bhahotola kulola kabhele,

content: Bhahe, pajhomolila kuchoma ajhakukighubika kitabo chela, na kumujhichila ntumiche na kutama pahe. Bhando bhoha bhibhakibha nkate jha munyumba jha kukonganikii Akayahude, bhajhakupikiya miho,
Jwenio ajhakwalobholela, “Lijhandiko lende litimile deleno punyokanikiya likachomwa.”
Bhando bhoha bhajhakuhutilwa nako na kuhechuka nhwalo gwa Malobhe gha Mbone ghabhalongolila. Bhajhakukonyana, “Bho, jwenio mwana gwa Uchupo ndeka?”
Yecho ajhakwalobholela, “Manyite naunongolela nnandanikiho ghongo, ‘Nghanga mukilamicha mabhene!’ Malobhe ghoha ghitujhohina ghuhengita kwenio kukapelenaumo, mughahenge peniya pa muche gwito.”
Yecho pajhendilila kwalongolela, “Ninnobholela chakaka, abhii jhe nnondole jwa Chapanga jhubhakung'ila pa muche gwake.”

“Nambo unyokanikiya ninongolela, chakaka bhakibha akanawela bhamahele pa kilambo chuku Ichilahele machiko gwa Eliya, machiko ghenagha hula ikalekite kukoma kwa yaka itato na miyehe chita, pajhakubhehe na njala ngolongwa pakilambo choha.
Nambo Eliya akatumitwe ndeka kujhenda kwa mwikeghe nawela jhojhoha jhola, nga kwa jhumo jwatamita kumuche gwa ku Cheleputa, ku kilambo chuku Sidone.
Mu machiko gha Elicha jwakibha nnondole jwa Chapanga, pakibha na bhando twe bhibhakibha na malohe ku Ichilahele, akibha ndeka mundo jwakajhelebhuka, nga Naamane, mundo jwa ku Siliya.”
Bhando bhoha bhibhakibha nkate munyumba jha kukonganikii Akayahude mola, bhajhakuyoma hake pibhajhohina ghenagha.
Bhajhakujhema, na kunghaghahana panja jha muche gwabhe ghuchengwite panane jha kitombe. Bhajhakuhutila ade mupele mwa ling'engo lya kitombe bhapata bhakangii pahe.
Nambo Yecho ajhakuholota pakate jha lilongo lela, ajhakukijhendela.
Mundo jwabhii na nchuka
Peniya Yecho pahelila ade kubomane jha ku kapelenaumo, ku kilambo chuku Galilaya. Na lichiko lya Kupomolela abholita bhando.
Bhakahechwike hake na mabholelo ghake, na malobhe ghake ghina ukindendeke.
Peniya ndi, nkate munyumba jha kukonganikii Akayahude mola, akibha mundo jhumo jwabhii na nchuka. Ajhakulalama alongila,
“Oko! Mwe ma Yecho bhuku Nachalete mipala nike kwito? Ko! Bho, uhikite kutukoma? Nenga, nimanyite mwenga maghane, Mwenga manyahinyahi bha Chapanga!”
Yecho ajhakuupwatalila nchuka alongila, “Tama nuu! Mumoke mundo jhonjo!” Na nchuka ujhakugwiya pahe mundo jhola, changa hingondokondo.
Bhando bhoha bhakakangiche, bhajhakulongelana malobhe bhene chika mabholo ghanga ghabhii bhole? “Mundo hojho abhii na ukindendeke na makakala gha kuhilobholela michuka ibhoke, na jhene ikabhoka!”
Malobhe ghake Yecho ghajhakuchobhela pa kilambo choha.
Yecho ilamicha bhando
Yecho papitita munyumba jha kukonganikii Akayahude, ajhakujhenda ukajha kwa Simone. Kwenio akibha nkohano mundo Simone mwikeghe atehila kulwalwa, bhajhakunyopa Yecho anamiche.
Yecho, ajhakujhenda pabhii majhe jhola, ajhakujhinama na kuupwatalila ulwalo ghola, papalapala majhe ajhakulama, ajhakujhinuka na kutumbuu kwatelekela.
Lyobha pulitumbwila kutipika, bhando bhoha bhibhalwalwa ulwalo ghoghoha ghola, bhabhutwiya ade kwa Yecho, na jwenio abhabhekila mabhoko kwa kila jhumo jwiilwalwa, ajhakulamicha bhoha.
Bhahe, michuka ijhakwachomoka bhando bhamahele, ilongila, “Mwenga ma Mwana bha Chapanga!” Nambo Yecho ajhakwapwatalila, alekita jhe kulonge, nhwalo bhamanyite jwenio ndi Kilichitu Nkomboche.
Yecho itangacha munyumba jha kukonganikii Akayahude
Patondogholo lukela jhake, Yecho ajhakujhenda pangabhando. Bhando bhatehila kumpalaha kwabhile, na pubhamwonita bhajhakuhibhilikiya akotoka kubhoka.
Nambo jwenie Yecho ajhakwalobholela, “Imbala kutangacha Malobhe gha Mbone gha Unahota nkolongwa gwa Chapanga kwa miche jhenge helahela, ndumitwe kwa nhwalo ghogho.”
Peniya ndi ajhakujhendelela kutangacha Malobhe gha Mbone munyumba jha kukonganikii Akayahude jha ku Yudeya jhoha.
